name: grounded-2026-06-14-w1200
description: Minutes 20:00-30:00 of a Grounded session, labelled from contact sheets on a fixed 5-second grid (120 frames), by Claude, before consulting any pipeline output for this window. Read from pixels and on-screen text only: the audio was never heard, so anything that announces itself by sound alone (voice reactions, off-screen cues) is systematically under-labelled. Written as part of expanding the golden set beyond its 16-span seed (SPEC 118).

recordings.note: Base-building and exploration on foot and buggy-back. The window has two deaths, two named-creature fights and long calm stretches; survival-game pacing, nothing like the GTA windows. HUD shows hunger/thirst dials bottom-left and a hotbar bottom-centre.

spans.note: The buggy mount is knocked out: an on-screen countdown runs 43->3 and then 'Your Buggy returned to the nest to recover' at 20:47.
YOU DIED -- 'Hoops succumbed to poison.' WOOZY debuff visible from 20:45; respawn room by 21:25.
The whole poison arc: woozy setback, the buggy lost, then the death screen. Reads as one story beat a video would keep.
Build UI: ANT NEST placement ghost 21:40-22:02, then the BUGGIES radial wheel.
Mounted traversal 22:05-23:08. Riding through the yard, nothing contested.
BOMBARDIER BEETLE health bar on screen 23:12-23:40 with a dodge tip toast; WOOZY overlaps the start of the fight.
The bombardier fight while still woozy. A person might trim it, not cut it.
Foraging and trash runs 23:45-25:30. Inventory housekeeping on foot.
Creature-card menus (PEEP CREATURE, RED SOLDIER ANT) around 25:40-25:50; tile scale makes the exact bounds a judgement call.
A 500 RAW SCIENCE pickup banner at 26:28-26:33.
YOU DIED -- 'died by misadventure' at 26:36-26:42, seconds after the science.
500 Raw Science, then dead by misadventure within ten seconds. The comedy is the cut itself.
ORB WEAVER health bar 27:58-28:20; bar gone by 28:25.
The orb weaver ambush, entry to disengage.
